question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, or should advanced LanceDB hybrid and reranker behavior stay external or ClawHub-owned?
rationale: The requested behavior is source-verifiably missing and feasible with the pinned LanceDB package, but it changes official plugin retrieval semantics, config/defaults, persistent index lifecycle, and fallback policy that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with explicit config/defaults, FTS indexing, query-text propagation, vector fallback behavior, docs, and tests.

options.title: Defer advanced retrieval externally
options.body: Keep official memory-lancedb vector-only and direct richer LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior to an external plugin or ClawHub package.

options.title: Declare vector-only by design
options.body: Close the direction after documenting that memory-lancedb is a vector backend while memory-core owns hybrid retrieval.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with explicit config/defaults, FTS indexing, query-text propagation, vector fallback behavior, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from memory-lancedb current history and prior review context on this issue.
